Completeness verdicts across departments: 38 complete, 8 incomplete, 0 contested, 74 unexamined (unexamined means not crawled yet — never counted as a pass).
Last QC pass: flagging problems (175 clean, 0 suspicious, 112 defect).
Processing ladder: 228 of 4792 pulled are fully processed — PDF archived on archive.org, text extracted, read by eoreader7, small files on GitHub (642 archived, 254 read).

Every count is a concrete lower bound; caps are declared, never hidden.
Self-healing: 18 oversight action(s) on record (restart/ream/timer arms, fetch pauses on disk pressure) — each with a falsifying control.
